== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|[[Kazan]] Ma Deret is a member of the [[Kazan clan]], a group characterized by their use of red banners featuring Stone Dogs and an extensive culture of wearing armor. Members of his clan, including women, men, and children, typically wear various forms of metal plating or mail integrated into their clothing, often accompanied by large copper or [[Iron|iron]] badges. Ma Deret is a [[Forger]] who follows the [[Path of the Mountain’s Heart]], a discipline that allows him to create powerful constructs, such as crushing weapons or walls. He is noted for his physical strength and talent, having climbed stairs with notable speed. During a confrontation involving an elder and a character named [[Lindon]], Ma Deret displayed an aggressive temperament, physically attacking his opponent and questioning the legitimacy of those who survived a trial that claimed a [[sacred artist]]. Despite his abilities, he was eventually defeated and wounded by [[Lindon]] during a struggle in the snow.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|[[Kazan]] Ma Deret is an [[Iron]] with brown hair. This individual also wears an [[Iron|iron]] badge.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|As a [[Forger]], [[Kazan]] Ma Deret walks the [[Path of the Mountain’s Heart]]. This person utilizes red-brown bricks made of solid [[madra]] that have been forged.}}

== Unsouled ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|[[Kazan]] Ma Deret is a brown-haired [[Iron]] who follows the [[Path of the Mountain’s Heart]]. As a [[Forger]], they wear an [[Iron|iron]] badge to signify their status. In their practice, [[Kazan]] Ma Deret utilizes red-brown bricks that have been forged from solid [[madra]].}}
